context: A boss reviews a special-edition product plan
purpose: Teach: 数量/要領/対談/補佐/試行錯誤/フォーマット/一昨年/当分

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今期の限定品、数量と要領を整理してくれ。
lines.en: Clean up the quantity and specifics on this term's limited product.
lines.style: Clipped, expectant opening. Direct eye contact. No preamble — straight into the assignment. Efficient breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広報部長との対談形式で、社内告知を進める予定です。
lines.en: Yes. We're planning to roll out the internal announcement through a dialogue format with the PR director.
lines.style: Steady, methodical delivery. Matter-of-fact tone showing he's already thought this through. Slight professional deference in the structure — reporting confidence, not seeking approval.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 補佐の井上にも、フォーマット確認させとけ。
lines.en: Have Inoue in your support team verify the format as well.
lines.style: Quick, practical instruction. No elaboration needed — assumes competence. Brief pause between clauses. Tone: delegating downward with trust.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 一昨年の販促資料、流用は当分難しいので、試行錯誤しています。
lines.en: The promotional materials from two years back won't be viable for a while, so we're working through iterations right now.
lines.style: Slightly apologetic undertone — explaining the constraint, not making excuses. Even pace. Shows forward motion despite the friction. Professional but forthcoming.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 頼む。来週、初稿を出してくれ。
lines.en: I need a first draft by next week.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Light emphasis on 「来週」. Closing note — conversation nearly done. Expectant, not negotiable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Sharp, respectful acknowledgment. Brief. The sound of someone taking the directive on board and moving forward.
